_comment: MASTER SITE CONFIG. Standalone brand, standalone repository, standalone URL. Product mix and price band chosen from 2026 TikTok Shop category data: beauty leads GMV, jewelry carries the best margin, and $15-30 is the conversion sweet spot.

store.name: SOFTLAUNCH
store.tagline: The drop everyone's about to have.
store.description: Softlaunch is a short-form shop for the beauty, jewelry and everyday-object drops that go viral first and sell out second. Small edits, honest prices, free shipping over $35.

_domain_note: base_url is a placeholder until a domain is bought. share_url is what the in-page Share button copies — point it at the real domain once live. Both are single-line changes.

payments._comment: Multiple ways to pay, in order of how little setup they need. PayPal.me and Cash App need only a username — the amount goes in the URL, so the cart can hand off a real total today. Stripe adds Visa/Mastercard/Amex, Cash App Pay, Apple Pay and Google Pay on a hosted page, and is what you want long term. Whatever is filled in here is what the checkout sheet offers; empty entries are hidden rather than shown broken.

card.note: Visa, Mastercard, Amex, plus Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link and Cash App Pay on Stripe's hosted checkout. Per-product links live in products.json under checkout_url.

paypal.note: Your paypal.me handle only — no API keys. The cart opens paypal.me/<handle>/<total>. Test with $1 before going live.

cashapp.note: Your $Cashtag only. The cart opens cash.app/$<cashtag>/<total>. US only. Test with $1 before going live.

fallback.note: With nothing configured the cart still produces a complete itemised order by email, so no button is ever dead.

shipping.note: Free US shipping over $35. Flat $4.95 under.

conversion._comment: Levers rendered honestly — no invented ratings, sold counts, countdowns or stock numbers. Those get fabricated constantly in this category and they are the fastest way to lose a customer twice.
